# Get data

```{r}

# dependencies
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(janitor)
library(patchwork)

# get data
data_processed_participant_level <- read_csv("../../data/processed/multiverse/data_processed_participant_level.csv")

```

Number of scoring methods implemented = `r ncol(data_processed_participant_level)-1`.

# Correlate scores

```{r}

# count scoring strategies
n_scoring_strategies <- data_processed_participant_level |>
  select(-id) |>
  colnames() |>
  length()

# Correlation table
cors_decks_combined <- data_processed_participant_level |>
  select(-id) |>
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs") |>
  round(2)

diag(cors_decks_combined) <- NA

```

## Between modal scoring strategy and all others 

```{r}

# Correlation between modal scoring method and all others
data_cors_combined_modal <- 
  tibble(cors = as_tibble(cors_decks_combined)$C_plus_D_minus_A_plus_B) |>
  drop_na()

data_cors_combined_modal |>
  summarize(n_correlations = n(),
            min = min(cors),
            max = max(cors),
            median = median(cors),
            mad = mad(cors)) |>
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round_half_up, digits = 2) |>
  kable() |>
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE)

## native 
p_native_modal <- ggplot(data_cors_combined_modal, aes(cors)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = .1, boundary = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 7), name = "Frequency") +
  ggtitle("Modal scoring strategy vs. all others") +
  #xlab(expression(paste("Pearson's ",italic("r")))) +
  xlab("Correlation") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1,1)) +
  theme_bw()

## absolute
p_absolute_modal <- ggplot(data_cors_combined_modal, aes(abs(cors))) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = .1, boundary = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 7), name = "Frequency") +
  #ggtitle("Absolute correlation between modal scoring strategy and all others") +
  #xlab(expression(paste("|Pearson's ",italic("r"), "|"))) +
  xlab("Absolute correlation") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,1)) +
  theme_bw()

p_native_modal
p_absolute_modal

```

## Between all scoring methods

```{r}

# Correlation between all scoring methods
cors_decks_combined[lower.tri(cors_decks_combined, diag = TRUE)] <- NA

data_cors_combined <- tibble(cors = cors_decks_combined[upper.tri(cors_decks_combined)])

data_cors_combined |>
  summarize(n_correlations = n(),
            min = min(cors, na.rm = TRUE),
            max = max(cors, na.rm = TRUE),
            median = median(cors, na.rm = TRUE),
            mad = mad(cors, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round_half_up, digits = 2) |>
  kable() |>
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE)

## native 
p_native_all <- ggplot(data_cors_combined, aes(cors)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = .1, boundary = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 7), name = "Frequency") +
  ggtitle("All scoring strategies") +
  #xlab(expression(paste("Pearson's ",italic("r")))) +
  xlab("Correlation") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1,1)) +
  theme_bw()

## absolute
p_absolute_all <- ggplot(data_cors_combined, aes(abs(cors))) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = .1, boundary = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 7), name = "Frequency") +
  #ggtitle("Absolute correlation between all scoring strategies") +
  #xlab(expression(paste("|Pearson's ",italic("r"), "|"))) +
  xlab("Absolute correlation") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,1)) +
  theme_bw()

p_native_all
p_absolute_all

```

## Combined

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=8}

p_native_all +
  p_native_modal +
  p_absolute_all +
  p_absolute_modal +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, nrow = 2)

ggsave("plot.pdf", width = 9, height = 6)
ggsave("plot.png", width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 600)

```
